observations: Two sewing machine stands are shown, one with a blue patterned top and one with a wood-grain patterned top.
The stands feature ornate cast iron legs and a central treadle mechanism.
The treadle footrests are visible in photos 0, 1, 2, and 3.
The top surfaces appear to be made of plastic or laminated wood.
The stands are placed outdoors on a cracked concrete surface.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SESHMAK TECH' are visible across all photos.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The stands may be missing the sewing machines or the treadles.
risks.proof: A photo of both stands with the machines attached.

risks.risk: The cast iron may be rusted or pitted, especially on the underside.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the stands.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism may be seized or the footrests may be broken.
risks.proof: A video of the treadles being operated.

proof_requests: Photos of the sewing machines attached to the stands.
A photo of the underside of the stands to check for rust.
A video showing the treadles being operated.
Photos of the machine heads to confirm they are present and in good condition.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as sewing machine stands. They can be priced at their worst-case condition (missing machines, rusted metal, non-functional treadles) until the proof asked for below arrives.
